en.headline: Chief Executive congratulates Hong Kong athletes on 41-medal Para Games haul
en.dek: Hong Kong, China finished the Asian Para Games in Nagoya with three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals, including a women’s sabre team silver on the final day.
body: Chief Executive John Lee congratulated Hong Kong, China athletes on Saturday for winning a total of 41 medals at the fifth Asian Para Games in Nagoya, which concluded that day.

The haul comprised three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals. Lee noted that the boccia squad achieved its best-ever result with two gold, three silver and three bronze medals. On the final day the women’s sabre team of Yu Chui-yee, Lam Ka-man, Tong Nga-ting and Chung Yuen-ping took silver, losing 16-30 to the national team in the gold-medal match.

Lee said the athletes had given their utmost, demonstrating superb skills and indomitable determination. Their achievements had brought honour to Hong Kong and inspired the community with their perseverance and never-give-up sportsmanship. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law also congratulated the contingent on five more medals on the closing day.

zh.headline: 行政長官恭賀港隊亞殘運奪41面獎牌
zh.dek: 香港代表團在名古屋亞殘運以3金14銀24銅完結，最終日女子佩劍團體賽再添一銀。
body: 行政長官李家超今日恭賀香港代表團在第五屆亞洲殘疾人運動會取得共41面獎牌，賽事於今日閉幕。
獎牌包括3金、14銀及24銅。李家超指出，硬地滾球隊締造曆來最佳成績，共奪2金3銀3銅。最終日，由余翠怡、林嘉雯、湯雅婷及鍾婉萍組成的女子佩劍團體隊在決賽以16比30不敵國家隊，奪得銀牌。
李家超表示，港隊運動員全力以赴，展現高超技巧及堅毅意志。他們的成就不但為香港帶來榮譽，亦以永不放棄的體育精神激勵社會。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩亦恭賀港隊在閉幕日再添5面獎牌。
